about_short_description.short_description: Promeet provides features that enable creators to monetize their content and earn revenue.

product.name: Promeet Store
product.description: A platform feature that allows creators to set up a personalized online store to upload digital content, set prices, and sell directly to their audience with instant blockchain-based payments.

product.name: Instant Blockchain Payments
product.description: A payment system that uses blockchain technology to provide creators with immediate, peer-to-peer payouts in stablecoins, bypassing traditional financial intermediaries.

product.name: Live Video Chatrooms with Monetization
product.description: A web3-enabled service allowing creators to host encrypted live video sessions with audience members who pay per session or per minute using cryptocurrency.

product.name: Content Promotion and Analytics
product.description: Tools that enable creators to share their Promeet store link across social platforms and websites, with real-time analytics on visits, clicks, and sales to optimize audience engagement.

product.name: Referral Program (Become a ProMeeter)
product.description: A referral service that allows users to earn lifetime revenue shares by inviting creators to join Promeet and monetize their content on the platform.
